name: Skate Style
description:
About This Game

About This Game

Skate Style is the next-generation skateboarding experience that puts creativity and control in your hands. Blend physics-driven gameplay with a powerful animation editor to define your own style—no two tricks will ever look the same.

Key Features

Animation Studio – Perfect your style by adjusting body movement, foot placement, and timing. Replicate legendary pros or invent something completely new.

Physics-Based Trick System – Every push, flip, and grind is powered by responsive physics. Tricks feel real, with feet actually catching the board—pure, dynamic skateboarding.

Advanced Character Editor – Customize every detail of your skater: faces, bodies, clothing, hairstyles, and complete board setups.

Replay & Clip Editor – Capture your best lines with cinematic tools, slow motion, and dynamic angles. Share edits and showcase your style.

Iconic Real-World Maps

  • Barcelona – Skate MACBA and beyond, from plazas to hidden alleys.

  • Stalin Plaza (Prague) – The legendary flatground spot recreated in stunning detail.

Built for the Community – Mod support, replay sharing, and regular updates create a platform for skaters, creators, and filmers.

Realism Meets Artistry – From gritty concrete textures to scuffed decks, Skate Style blends cutting-edge graphics with smooth performance, supporting everything from high-end rigs with ray tracing to handheld play on the Steam Deck.

Define your tricks. Define your look. Define your style.
short_desc: Skate Style is a next-gen skateboarding game with high-end graphics, an advanced character creator, and a built-in animation editor. Skate iconic spots like Barcelona and Prague, create your style, and share it with friends. Enjoy precise dual stick controls for ultimate trick freedom.
